svg.title: IR fingerprint comparison for liquid L
svg.desc: Schematic transmittance spectra compare liquid L with octan-4-one and octan-2-one references across the fingerprint window. The matching pattern supports a choice only within the stated candidate set; ordinary IR generally cannot distinguish enantiomers.
svg.text: IR fingerprinting: compare the pattern, not one peak
Use the crowded region after functional-group checks narrow the candidates.
1 A matching pattern supports octan-4-one within the stated candidate set.
2 Both ketones share C=O and C–H features; those bands alone do not distinguish them.
Ordinary IR generally cannot distinguish enantiomers. These spectra are schematic, not measured.
